mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (site_id, path, preview_url, state, locked_by, created_by, created_on, last_modified_by, last_modified_on, label, content_type_id, system_type, mime_type, locale_code, translation_source_id, size, parent_id, ignored) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{path}, #{previewUrl}, #{state}, #{lockedBy}, #{createdBy}, #{createdOn}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{lastModifiedOn}, #{label}, #{contentTypeId}, #{systemType}, #{mimeType}, #{localeCode}, #{translationSourceId}, #{size}, #{parentId}, #{ignoredAsInt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE site_id = #{siteId}, path = #{path}, preview_url = #{previewUrl}, state = #{state}, locked_by = #{lockedBy}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_on = #{lastModifiedOn}, label = #{label}, content_type_id = #{contentTypeId}, system_type = #{systemType}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, locale_code = #{localeCode}, translation_source_id = #{translationSourceId}, size = #{size}, parent_id = #{parentId}, ignored = #{ignoredAsInt}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM item child LEFT JOIN item parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.site_id = #{siteId} AND (parent.path = #{path} OR parent.path = CONCAT(#{path}, '/index.xml')) AND (parent.system_type != 'folder' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM item page WHERE page.site_id = parent.site_id AND page.system_type = 'page' AND page.path = CONCAT(parent.path, '/index.xml'))) AND child.ignored = 0 AND ( child.system_type != 'folder' OR NOT EXISTS ( select * from item page where page.site_id = child.site_id and page.path = concat(child.path, '/index.xml') ) )
mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, i.locked_by AS lock_owner, i.created_by AS creator, i.last_modified_by AS modifier, ( SELECT pp1.schedule FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE ipi1.item_id = i.id AND pp1.target = #{stagingEnvironment} AND pp1.package_state = #{readyState} AND pp1.approval_state = #{approvedState} ORDER BY pp1.submitted_on DESC LIMIT 0, 1 ) AS staging_scheduled_date, ( SELECT pp1.schedule FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE ipi1.item_id = i.id AND pp1.target = #{liveEnvironment} AND pp1.package_state = #{readyState} AND pp1.approval_state = #{approvedState} ORDER BY pp1.submitted_on DESC LIMIT 0, 1 ) as live_scheduled_date, publishStaging.published_on AS staging_last_published_on, publishStaging.submitter_id AS staging_submitter_id, publishLive.published_on AS live_last_published_on, publishLive.submitter_id AS live_submitter_id, COUNT (DISTINCT ichild.id) AS children_count FROM item i INNER JOIN site s1 ON i.site_id = s1.id LEFT OUTER JOIN item ichild ON i.id = ichild.parent_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ipi1.item_id, pp1.published_on, pp1.submitter_id as submitter_id FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE pp1.target = #{stagingEnvironment} AND (pi1.publish_state & #{stagingPublishedState}) > 0 ORDER BY pp1.published_on desc LIMIT 0, 1 ) as publishStaging ON publishStaging.item_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ipi1.item_id, pp1.published_on, pp1.submitter_id AS submitter_id FROM item_publish_item ipi1 INNER JOIN publish_item pi1 ON ipi1.publish_item_id = pi1.id INNER JOIN publish_package pp1 ON pi1.package_id = pp1.id WHERE pp1.target = #{liveEnvironment} AND (pi1.publish_state & #{livePublishedState}) > 0 ORDER BY pp1.published_on desc LIMIT 0, 1 ) as publishLive ON publishLive.item_id = i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET site_id = #{siteId}, path = #{path}, preview_url = #{previewUrl}, state = #{state}, locked_by = #{lockedBy}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_on = #{lastModifiedOn}, label = #{label}, content_type_id = #{contentTypeId}, system_type = #{systemType}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, locale_code = #{localeCode}, translation_source_id = #{translationSourceId}, size = #{size}, parent_id = #{parentId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE item_target it INNER JOIN item i ON i.id = it.item_id INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = i.site_id
SET it.previous_path = IF(it.previous_path = #{newPath}, NULL, IFNULL(it.previous_path, #{previousPath})) WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.path = #{newPath}
mapper.select:
SELECT count(1) FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND i.system_type NOT IN
#{type}
SELECT i.path FROM item i WHERE i.site_id = #{siteId} AND i.ignored = 0 AND (i.state & #{states}) > 0

SELECT i.path, i.system_type AS meta_systemType, i.label AS meta_label, i.mime_type AS meta_mime_type FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND ( (i.system_type IN ('page', 'component') AND I.content_type_id = #{contentType}) OR (i.system_type = 'script' AND i.path = #{scriptPath}) )

SELECT count(1) FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0 AND i.system_type != 'folder'
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0

SELECT i.*, i.locked_by AS lock_owner, i.created_by AS creator, i.last_modified_by AS modifier FROM item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0 AND i.system_type != 'folder'
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update:
UPDATE item i INNER JOIN site s ON i.site_id = s.id SET i.state = (i.state | #{onStatesBitMap}) & ~#{offStatesBitMap} WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.ignored = 0
AND i.path RLIKE(#{path})
AND (i.state & #{statesBitMap}) > 0

UPDATE item, (SELECT child.id AS childId, (SELECT i.id FROM item i INNER JOIN site s on s.id = i.site_id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND i.path = concat(#{path}, '/index.xml')) AS newParentId FROM item child INNER JOIN item parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = child.site_id WHERE s.site_id = #{siteId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND parent.path = #{path} ) AS updates SET item.parent_id = updates.newParentId WHERE item.id = updates.childId
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS (SELECT i.id, i.path, i.site_id, i.system_type FROM item i WHERE i.path = TRIM(TRAILING '/' from #{path}) AND i.site_id = #{siteId} UNION SELECT i.id, i.path, i.site_id, i.system_type FROM cte, item i WHERE cte.id = i.parent_id AND cte.site_id = #{siteId} AND i.ignored = 0) SELECT cte.path FROM cte WHERE cte.system_type <> 'folder'
